data.title: Week 1 quiz · Si Her Collective Capital

questions.questionText: Which example best illustrates collective capital?

options.text: One person funds and controls every decision
Members pool resources and decide together how to support a shared goal
A company stores its files on a blockchain
A creator receives a private loan with no community role

questions.questionText: Why should a community define decision rules before allocating a shared treasury?

options.text: To guarantee that every project receives funding
To make funding decisions transparent and accountable
To prevent members from asking questions

questions.questionText: What should members clarify when designing a collective funding model?

options.text: Who contributes, who decides, and who benefits
Only the number of social followers
